summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (last Graph method, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested recursive helper add_to_cbd: step (a) adds subject triples and recurses into BNode objects not yet expanded; step (b) adds all triples of every rdf:subject reifier of the node (typed or untyped); no recursion from step (b). Created test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering rule 1/2 counts, typed/untyped reifiers, incoming reification, blank node in reification not expanded, blank-node cycle, and source immutability; imports only unittest, Graph, Namespace; ends with main guard. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. Test counts were computed by hand against my own fixture, not the reference fixture, so they differ from the spec's example numbers.
